sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Several years of progressive experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001; knowledge and experience with AS9100 strongly preferred for aerospace and defense environments.
* Demonstrated experience with 8D, CAPA, root-cause analysis, FMEA, SPC, APQP, PPAP, and corrective/preventive quality methods as applicable.
* Experience leading internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Experience managing customer complaints, supplier quality issues, nonconforming material, and corrective actions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and quality management / ERP software systems.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
